goals.title: Wear a rune platebody
goals.summary: A longer combat and questing ambition for a free-to-play account.
benefits: Equip the strongest standard free-to-play platebody for melee defence.
Work towards a memorable quest encounter with Elvarg.
goals.investment: Longer ambition from a new account: quest points, combat preparation, Defence training and obtaining the armour. No fixed time estimate.
preparation: Dragon Slayer I requires 32 quest points to start. Choose quests you enjoy; there is no mandatory list of earlier quests.
Prepare for a level 83 dragon and other combat. Suggested combat levels are advice, not hard skill requirements.
Obtain the platebody after unlocking it. Buying it does not bypass the quest or Defence requirement.
Dragon Slayer I grants Defence XP, so its reward can contribute towards level 40.

requirements.label: 32 quest points to start Dragon Slayer I
requirements.note: Quest entry context, not a specific quest route. Completing Dragon Slayer I is the unlock milestone above.

requirements.label: Equip a rune platebody
requirements.note: This is a separate observed milestone: meeting requirements or buying the item does not mean it has been worn.

goals.title: Unlock Ardougne cloak 1
goals.summary: An exploration and travel utility goal for members.
benefits: Unlimited teleports to the Ardougne Monastery, near an altar.
Learn how regional achievement diaries combine different activities.
goals.investment: A regional project: several quests, level 5 Thieving, ten diary tasks and claiming the reward. Travel and gathering supplies add effort.
preparation: An achievement diary is a regional checklist. Its easy tasks may be completed in any order.
Bring silk, a rusty sword and coins; review the task descriptions before travelling.
The lever task enters the Wilderness, where other players can attack you. Bank valuables first and understand the risk before attempting it.
The cake task needs 5 Thieving; temporary boosts can satisfy diary skill requirements. Demo progress uses the recorded base level only.
Claim the reward from Two-pints at the Flying Horse Inn after completing the easy tasks.

requirements.label: Reach 5 Thieving (or use a suitable boost)
Complete all ten easy Ardougne Diary tasks

children.label: Teleport to the essence mine with Wizard Cromperty
Steal a cake from an Ardougne market stall
Sell silk to the Ardougne silk trader for 60 coins
Use the East Ardougne church altar with missing Prayer points
Have Tindel Marchant identify a rusty sword
Use the Ardougne lever to enter the Wilderness
children.note: Enters the Wilderness. Bank valuables and understand PvP risk first.

children.label: View Aleck's Hunter Emporium in Yanille

requirements.label: Claim Ardougne cloak 1 from Two-pints
requirements.note: Diary tasks done and reward claimed are separate observations.

goals.title: Complete Prince Ali Rescue
goals.summary: Remove the Al Kharid toll for easier free-to-play travel.
benefits: Pass the Lumbridge–Al Kharid toll gate without paying its 10-coin fee.
Earn 3 quest points and 700 coins.
goals.investment: Short quest, with item gathering and travel between Al Kharid and Draynor. Gathering everything yourself takes longer than buying supplies.
preparation: No prior quests or minimum skill levels are required. You must be able to get past aggressive level 26 jail guards; fighting them is optional.
Supplies include soft clay, three balls of wool, yellow dye (or onions and coins), redberries, ashes, water, flour, a bronze bar, a pink skirt, three beers and rope.
Start by speaking to Hassan in Al Kharid palace. Gather supplies to learn basic activities, or buy them if you prefer to focus on the quest.
This removes a gate toll; it does not unlock Al Kharid, which is already accessible.

goals.title: Complete Cook's Assistant
goals.summary: A first taste of questing and gathering around Lumbridge.
benefits: Earn 1 quest point and 300 Cooking XP.
Gain permission to use the Lumbridge castle kitchen range.
goals.investment: Short gathering quest. Collecting ingredients yourself introduces nearby activities; buying them reduces the gathering effort.
preparation: Speak to the Cook in Lumbridge castle kitchen. No prior quests or skill levels are required.
Bring an egg, a bucket of milk and a pot of flour. You can gather these locally or buy them. No combat is required.

requirements.label: Complete Cook's Assistant
requirements.note: Speak to the Cook in Lumbridge castle kitchen. No prior quests or skill levels are required.

goals.title: Complete The Restless Ghost
goals.summary: Explore Lumbridge and take a first step into Prayer progression.
benefits: Earn 1 quest point and 1,125 Prayer XP.
Receive a ghostspeak amulet used in other adventures.
goals.investment: Short quest with travel around Lumbridge, the swamp and the Wizards' Tower. Allow for navigating and avoiding a skeleton.
preparation: Speak to Father Aereck in Lumbridge church. No prior quests or minimum skill levels are required.
Be prepared to avoid or fight a level 13 skeleton. Killing it is optional; bring food if needed.

requirements.label: Complete The Restless Ghost
requirements.note: Speak to Father Aereck in Lumbridge church. No prior quests or minimum skill levels are required.

goals.title: Complete Rune Mysteries
goals.summary: Learn about rune essence and visit several early-game locations.
benefits: Unlock mining rune essence.
Earn 1 quest point and prepare a prerequisite used by several diaries.
goals.investment: Short dialogue and travel quest between Lumbridge, the Wizards' Tower and Varrock. No combat is required.
preparation: Speak to Duke Horacio upstairs in Lumbridge castle. No prior quests or skill levels are required.
Follow the research deliveries using the quest journal. This unlocks rune essence mining; it is not a requirement for all Runecraft training.

requirements.label: Complete Rune Mysteries
requirements.note: Speak to Duke Horacio upstairs in Lumbridge castle. No prior quests or skill levels are required.

goals.title: Complete Plague City
goals.summary: Begin the Ardougne quest story and build towards diary prerequisites.
benefits: Earn 1 quest point and 2,425 Mining XP.
Unlock the next quest in the story, Biohazard.
goals.investment: Short members quest with gathering, dialogue and travel in Ardougne. Gathering supplies yourself adds effort.
preparation: Speak to Edmond in East Ardougne. Review the quest journal and supply list before travelling.
This quest contributes towards Ardougne cloak 1. Its teleport reward does not remove the Magic level or rune costs of casting Ardougne Teleport.

requirements.label: Complete Plague City
requirements.note: Speak to Edmond in East Ardougne. Review the quest journal and supply list before travelling.

goals.title: Reach 20 Attack for mithril weapons
goals.summary: An early melee equipment milestone.
benefits: Meet the Attack requirement for mithril melee weapons.
goals.investment: An early training project. Combat choices, equipment and quest rewards affect the effort.
preparation: Choose manageable fights and an attack style that awards Attack XP. Check the combat style panel before training.
Obtaining a weapon is separate from meeting its level requirement. Bring food and choose enemies you can handle.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 20 Attack
requirements.note: Choose manageable fights and an attack style that awards Attack XP. Check the combat style panel before training.

goals.title: Reach 40 Attack for rune weapons
goals.summary: A larger free-to-play melee ambition.
benefits: Meet the Attack requirement for a rune scimitar.
goals.investment: A longer melee milestone from level 1. You can mix training with quests that reward Attack XP.
preparation: Train Attack through manageable combat or suitable quest rewards; there is no mandatory training spot.
Choose an Attack XP combat style. Buying or equipping a rune weapon is not tracked by this goal.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 40 Attack
requirements.note: Train Attack through manageable combat or suitable quest rewards; there is no mandatory training spot.

goals.title: Reach 25 Magic for Varrock Teleport
goals.summary: A useful first spell-based travel milestone.
benefits: Meet the Magic level requirement for the standard Varrock Teleport spell.
goals.investment: An early Magic project with rune or training-supply costs. Your method and starting level determine the effort.
preparation: Choose a Magic training method you can afford and check the spell requirements before buying supplies.
Casting Varrock Teleport needs the standard spellbook and the appropriate runes. Reaching the level alone does not cast it.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 25 Magic
requirements.note: Choose a Magic training method you can afford and check the spell requirements before buying supplies.

goals.title: Reach 37 Magic for Falador Teleport
goals.summary: Expand your free-to-play travel options with a standard spellbook teleport.
benefits: Meet the Magic level requirement for Falador Teleport.
goals.investment: A broader Magic project than your first teleport. Allow for rune costs and your preferred training method.
preparation: Continue Magic training using a method that fits your supplies and budget.
The standard Falador Teleport spell still requires its runes. This goal tracks the base level, not a teleport cast.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 37 Magic
requirements.note: Continue Magic training using a method that fits your supplies and budget.

goals.title: Reach 43 Prayer for Protect from Melee
goals.summary: A major early combat utility milestone.
benefits: Unlock the Protect from Melee prayer.
goals.investment: A longer early-account project. Prayer training methods and supply costs vary substantially; no fixed time or price is assumed.
preparation: Choose Prayer training that suits your budget and account restrictions. Prayer XP from quests can contribute too.
Protection prayers consume Prayer points. Protect from Melee does not guarantee safety against every enemy or attack.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 43 Prayer
requirements.note: Choose Prayer training that suits your budget and account restrictions. Prayer XP from quests can contribute too.

goals.title: Reach 30 Fishing for salmon
goals.summary: A gathering goal that pairs naturally with cooking.
benefits: Meet the Fishing requirement for salmon, alongside trout at level 20.
goals.investment: An early gathering project. Getting tools and travelling to fishing spots adds some preparation.
preparation: Use fishing methods available at your current level. Fly fishing becomes an option at 20 Fishing.
Fly fishing for trout and salmon uses a fly fishing rod and feathers. Reaching 30 Fishing does not prove you have caught either fish.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 30 Fishing
requirements.note: Use fishing methods available at your current level. Fly fishing becomes an option at 20 Fishing.

goals.title: Reach 25 Cooking for salmon
goals.summary: An early food preparation milestone.
benefits: Meet the Cooking level requirement for salmon.
goals.investment: An early production project. Gathering your own fish trades extra time for less reliance on buying supplies.
preparation: Cook food available at your current level. You can gather raw food yourself or buy it.
Food can still burn after you reach its minimum Cooking level. This goal does not track a successful cook or food in your bank.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 25 Cooking
requirements.note: Cook food available at your current level. You can gather raw food yourself or buy it.

goals.title: Reach 30 Mining for coal
goals.summary: Explore gathering resources used in Smithing.
benefits: Meet the Mining requirement for coal rocks.
goals.investment: An early gathering project. Ore choice, travel and whether you bank resources affect the effort.
preparation: Bring a pickaxe and mine resources available at your current level. Choose between banking resources and focusing on training.
The level unlocks coal mining; it does not grant access to every coal location or certify that a location is safe.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 30 Mining
requirements.note: Bring a pickaxe and mine resources available at your current level. Choose between banking resources and focusing on training.

goals.title: Reach 15 Woodcutting for oak trees
goals.summary: A first gathering milestone close to Lumbridge.
benefits: Meet the Woodcutting level for oak trees.
goals.investment: A small introductory training goal. Current XP reduces the work remaining; supplies, methods and travel affect effort.
preparation: Bring an axe and cut regular trees available at level 1. Oaks near Lumbridge provide an optional next activity.
Choose whether to bank your logs for later use or focus on training. You can carry an axe without meeting its Attack requirement to wield it.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 15 Woodcutting
requirements.note: Bring an axe and cut regular trees available at level 1. Oaks near Lumbridge provide an optional next activity.

goals.title: Reach 30 Woodcutting for willow trees
goals.summary: Try another resource after your first Woodcutting milestone.
benefits: Meet the Woodcutting level for willow trees.
goals.investment: A focused training project from a new account. Current XP reduces the work remaining; supplies, methods and travel affect effort.
preparation: Cut trees available at your current level with an axe. Regular trees and then oaks are options; no fixed training route is required.
Choose a location that suits your combat level. The willows near Draynor bank have nearby aggressive dark wizards; other locations are available.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 30 Woodcutting
requirements.note: Cut trees available at your current level with an axe. Regular trees and then oaks are options; no fixed training route is required.

goals.title: Reach 5 Crafting for gold rings
goals.summary: Discover how gathering and production skills connect.
benefits: Meet the Crafting level to make plain gold rings.
goals.investment: A small introductory training goal. Current XP reduces the work remaining; supplies, methods and travel affect effort.
preparation: Try spinning wool at a spinning wheel or making leather items using tanned cowhide, a needle and thread.
Making a gold ring needs a gold bar, ring mould and furnace. Buying a bar avoids needing the Smithing level to smelt gold ore. Plain gold rings do not provide a teleport or enchanted effect.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 5 Crafting
requirements.note: Try spinning wool at a spinning wheel or making leather items using tanned cowhide, a needle and thread.

goals.title: Reach 30 Smithing for steel bars
goals.summary: Turn mined resources into a new tier of metal.
benefits: Meet the Smithing level to smelt steel bars.
goals.investment: A focused training project from a new account. Current XP reduces the work remaining; supplies, methods and travel affect effort.
preparation: Smelt or smith items available at your current level. Furnaces make bars; anvils use bars and a hammer to make equipment.
At a normal furnace, each steel bar needs one iron ore and two coal. You can buy resources; reaching this level does not mean you can smith every steel item.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 30 Smithing
requirements.note: Smelt or smith items available at your current level. Furnaces make bars; anvils use bars and a hammer to make equipment.

goals.title: Reach 20 Ranged for willow bows
goals.summary: Explore a combat style beyond melee.
benefits: Meet the Ranged requirement to wield willow bows.
goals.investment: A focused training project from a new account. Current XP reduces the work remaining; supplies, methods and travel affect effort.
preparation: Use a bow and compatible arrows against enemies you can handle. Check your attack style so you train the skill you intended.
Bring food and review enemy aggression. You still need to obtain a bow and suitable arrows; the plugin does not assess combat readiness.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 20 Ranged
requirements.note: Use a bow and compatible arrows against enemies you can handle. Check your attack style so you train the skill you intended.

goals.title: Reach 30 Ranged for maple bows
goals.summary: A further free-to-play ranged equipment milestone.
benefits: Meet the Ranged requirement to wield maple bows.
goals.investment: A focused training project from a new account. Current XP reduces the work remaining; supplies, methods and travel affect effort.
preparation: Train Ranged with equipment you can currently use and enemies you can handle; no particular monster is required.
Maple bows are free-to-play equipment. Obtaining the bow and compatible arrows is separate from reaching the level.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 30 Ranged
requirements.note: Train Ranged with equipment you can currently use and enemies you can handle; no particular monster is required.

goals.title: Reach 33 Magic for Telekinetic Grab
goals.summary: Discover a utility spell beyond combat and teleports.
benefits: Meet the Magic level for Telekinetic Grab on the standard spellbook.
goals.investment: A focused training project from a new account. Current XP reduces the work remaining; supplies, methods and travel affect effort.
preparation: Train with spells you can currently cast. Check rune supplies before setting out; combat is one option rather than a required route.
Telekinetic Grab uses one air rune and one law rune to collect suitable ground items from a distance. The level does not make dangerous item locations safe.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 33 Magic
requirements.note: Train with spells you can currently cast. Check rune supplies before setting out; combat is one option rather than a required route.

goals.title: Reach 40 Cooking for lobsters
goals.summary: Build on early food preparation with another food option.
benefits: Meet the Cooking level to cook raw lobster.
goals.investment: A focused training project from a new account. Current XP reduces the work remaining; supplies, methods and travel affect effort.
preparation: Cook food available at your current level on a range or fire. Gathering raw food and buying it are both options.
Raw lobster can be bought without having the Fishing level to catch it. Lobsters can still burn at the minimum Cooking level; supplies and successful cooking are not tracked.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 40 Cooking
requirements.note: Cook food available at your current level on a range or fire. Gathering raw food and buying it are both options.

goals.title: Reach 30 Agility for Varrock rooftops
goals.summary: Explore members movement training and a city rooftop course.
benefits: Meet the Agility requirement for the Varrock Rooftop Course.
goals.investment: A focused training project from a new account. Current XP reduces the work remaining; supplies, methods and travel affect effort.
preparation: Try an Agility course available at your current level, such as Draynor Village rooftops. Move to another course when you want variety.
Bring food where obstacles can cause damage. Rooftop marks of grace can contribute towards graceful equipment, but this goal does not track marks or an outfit purchase.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 30 Agility
requirements.note: Try an Agility course available at your current level, such as Draynor Village rooftops. Move to another course when you want variety.

goals.title: Reach 20 Thieving for silk stalls
goals.summary: Try a members skill with stalls and pickpocketing.
benefits: Meet the Thieving level to steal from silk stalls.
goals.investment: A focused training project from a new account. Current XP reduces the work remaining; supplies, methods and travel affect effort.
preparation: Try pickpocketing men or women, or stalls available at your current level. Bring food and check for nearby guards.
Stealing silk is separate from selling it for the easy Ardougne diary. You can obtain diary silk without this level; after stealing, the merchant temporarily refuses to trade.
Completion tracks your base skill level, not owning supplies, equipping an item or performing the unlocked activity. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 20 Thieving
requirements.note: Try pickpocketing men or women, or stalls available at your current level. Bring food and check for nearby guards.

goals.title: Complete Sheep Shearer
goals.summary: Explore wool gathering and spinning around Lumbridge.
benefits: Receive Crafting XP while learning a local production activity.
goals.investment: A short introductory quest. Gathering supplies yourself adds an activity; obtaining them elsewhere is also an option.
preparation: Speak to Fred the Farmer north of Lumbridge. No prior quests or minimum skill levels are required.
Fred needs 20 unnoted balls of wool. Shear sheep and spin wool at the Lumbridge castle spinning wheel, or obtain the balls elsewhere. Rams can be attacked and cannot be sheared.

requirements.label: Complete Sheep Shearer
requirements.note: Speak to Fred the Farmer north of Lumbridge. No prior quests or minimum skill levels are required.

goals.title: Complete Doric's Quest
goals.summary: Discover Mining supplies and a smithy near Falador.
benefits: Receive Mining XP and permission to use Doric's anvils.
goals.investment: A short introductory quest. Gathering supplies yourself adds an activity; obtaining them elsewhere is also an option.
preparation: Speak to Doric at his house north of Falador. No prior quests or minimum skill levels are required.

Bring six clay (not soft clay), four copper ore and two iron ore, all unnoted. Level 15 Mining is needed only if you choose to mine the iron yourself; obtaining it elsewhere avoids that training requirement.

requirements.label: Complete Doric's Quest
requirements.note: Speak to Doric at his house north of Falador. No prior quests or minimum skill levels are required.

goals.title: Reach 12 Woodcutting for basic canoes
goals.summary: A low-level free-to-play travel option along the river.
benefits: Meet the Woodcutting level to shape a log canoe at a canoe station.
goals.investment: A focused skill project. Current XP reduces the training remaining; methods, supplies and travel affect the effort.
preparation: Bring an axe and train on trees you can cut. At level 12, try a log canoe at a canoe station and use the destination menu to see its range.
Canoes are single-use: bring an axe to shape another for the return journey. Higher-tier canoes have greater range; this goal does not unlock every destination or the Wilderness route.
Completion tracks your base level, not using the unlocked activity or owning its supplies. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 12 Woodcutting
requirements.note: Bring an axe and train on trees you can cut. At level 12, try a log canoe at a canoe station and use the destination menu to see its range.

goals.title: Reach 31 Magic for Lumbridge Teleport
goals.summary: A free-to-play travel spell back to Lumbridge castle.
benefits: Meet the Magic level for the standard Lumbridge Teleport spell.
goals.investment: A focused skill project. Current XP reduces the training remaining; methods, supplies and travel affect the effort.
preparation: Train Magic using spells and supplies you can afford. Casting Lumbridge Teleport needs the standard spellbook, three air runes, one earth rune and one law rune.

The free Lumbridge Home Teleport already works without runes or a Magic level, but has a cooldown and can be interrupted. This goal is for the separate standard spell, not a requirement to visit Lumbridge.
Completion tracks your base level, not using the unlocked activity or owning its supplies. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 31 Magic
requirements.note: Train Magic using spells and supplies you can afford. Casting Lumbridge Teleport needs the standard spellbook, three air runes, one earth rune and one law rune.

goals.title: Reach 45 Magic for Camelot Teleport
goals.summary: A members travel spell to Camelot, near Seers' Village.
benefits: Meet the Magic level for the standard Camelot Teleport spell.
goals.investment: A focused skill project. Current XP reduces the training remaining; methods, supplies and travel affect the effort.
preparation: Continue Magic training with a method that fits your budget. Casting Camelot Teleport needs the standard spellbook, five air runes and one law rune.
Members can use a purchased Camelot teleport tablet without this Magic level. The spell normally arrives at Camelot; the Seers' bank destination needs the hard Kandarin diary.
Completion tracks your base level, not using the unlocked activity or owning its supplies. Temporary boosts do not complete this level milestone.

requirements.label: Reach 45 Magic
requirements.note: Continue Magic training with a method that fits your budget. Casting Camelot Teleport needs the standard spellbook, five air runes and one law rune.

goals.title: Obtain a Chronicle for Varrock travel
goals.summary: An early free-to-play travel tool without a Magic level requirement.
benefits: A charged Chronicle teleports outside the Champions' Guild, south of Varrock.
goals.investment: A small purchase and a trip to Draynor. The book costs 300 coins at Diango; teleport cards have a base shop price of 150 coins each.
preparation: Visit Diango in Draynor Village market for the Chronicle and teleport cards. Use the cards on the book before trying to teleport; each teleport consumes a charge.

This goal completes when the book is observed in your inventory or equipment. Charges, bank ownership and a successful teleport are not tracked. A completed purchase goal does not mean the book is still charged.
The destination is outside Varrock, not the Grand Exchange. Nearby dark wizards can threaten low-level players. The Chronicle cannot teleport from the Wilderness.

requirements.label: Obtain a Chronicle
requirements.note: Check your bank first. If needed, visit Diango in Draynor Village, buy a Chronicle and teleport cards, then charge the book. Carry the book for the plugin to observe ownership.

goals.title: Unlock spirit tree travel
goals.summary: A members quest goal that opens a network of travel destinations.
benefits: Complete Tree Gnome Village to use spirit tree transportation.
Travel between unlocked trees, including the Grand Exchange and the battlefield south of West Ardougne.
goals.investment: A quest project with travel, supplies and a combat encounter. No minimum skill level is required; combat preparation may add substantial effort.
preparation: Speak to King Bolren in the Tree Gnome Village maze. Bring six normal logs, combat equipment and food; review the quest before setting out.
You must defeat a level 112 Khazard warlord. Combat levels are preparation advice, not a checked hard requirement; this plugin does not assess readiness.
Some spirit trees have additional unlocks. The Gnome Stronghold tree needs The Grand Tree to depart from it, and other destinations have their own requirements. This goal does not unlock every tree.

requirements.label: Complete Tree Gnome Village
requirements.note: Speak to King Bolren in the Tree Gnome Village maze. Review supplies and preparation for the level 112 Khazard warlord before attempting the quest.

goals.title: Unlock gnome glider travel
goals.summary: A broader members travel network through a quest adventure.
benefits: Complete The Grand Tree to unlock the gnome glider transportation system.
Use the Gnome Stronghold spirit tree for departures once Tree Gnome Village is also complete.
goals.investment: A longer quest ambition involving Agility, travel and a combat encounter. Current skill and quest progress reduce the remaining work.
preparation: Speak to King Narnode Shareen in the Grand Tree. The quest needs 25 Agility to finish, but not to start; a suitable boost can satisfy the Agility obstacle.
Prepare to defeat a level 172 black demon. Ranged or Magic safespots are possible, but combat supplies and readiness still need a separate review.

Tree Gnome Village is not a prerequisite for this quest or for gliders. It is a separate unlock if you want to combine both travel networks. Individual glider destinations can have extra requirements.

requirements.label: Prepare 25 Agility for The Grand Tree
requirements.note: Required to finish, not to start. A suitable boost can satisfy the obstacle; this reading shows base level only.

requirements.label: Complete The Grand Tree
requirements.note: Speak to King Narnode Shareen in the Grand Tree. You can start before 25 Agility; review the obstacle requirement and preparation for the level 172 black demon.
